title: Every Night At 9:14, The Lights Come On (Part 1)
hook_note: Liminal mystery + survival + a dog companion, serialized with a cliffhanger.

scenes.narration: Every night, at exactly nine fourteen... every light in this dead city turns on. For one minute. Then... darkness.
scenes.visual: dark city skyline, every window snaps on at once, then off

scenes.narration: You've watched it happen two hundred and twelve nights in a row. From the same rooftop. With the same dog.
scenes.visual: rooftop at night, you and the dog sitting on the ledge, seen from behind

scenes.narration: His name is Biscuit. You found him on day three... shaking under a bus. Waiting for someone who was never coming back.
scenes.visual: flashback, rain, a small dog shivering under an abandoned bus, you crouch and reach out

scenes.narration: He's the reason you still get up in the morning. He's the reason you still talk out loud.
scenes.visual: candle-lit apartment, you sit on the floor talking to the dog, tail wagging

scenes.narration: Every day is the same. Search the stores. Take whatever's left. And always... give him the bigger half.
scenes.visual: empty supermarket aisle, you walk with a backpack, the dog trotting behind

scenes.narration: Nobody ever told you what happened. One morning, everyone was just gone. Cars still running. Coffee... still warm.
scenes.visual: grey dawn street, car door open, engine running, steaming coffee cup on the roof

scenes.narration: There was no warning. No news. Just a thousand screens... all saying the same two words.
scenes.visual: electronics store window, a wall of TVs all showing NO SIGNAL

scenes.narration: But tonight, at nine fourteen... something is different.
scenes.visual: rooftop, a glowing clock reads 9:14, you stand up slowly

scenes.narration: The city stays dark. Only one window lights up. Across the river. Top floor.
scenes.visual: dark skyline across a river, a single window lights up, camera pushes in

scenes.narration: And standing in that window... is a person. Waving at you.
scenes.visual: close on the lit window, a silhouette waving slowly

scenes.narration: Biscuit starts barking. He hasn't barked in months.
scenes.visual: the dog barking at the window, ears up

scenes.narration: You grab the binoculars. Your hands are shaking. They're holding up a sign.
scenes.visual: you raise binoculars; binocular view of the window, a figure lifting a sign
binocular view: the sign reads DON'T COME HERE

scenes.narration: They flip it over. On the back, in smaller letters... it's not me turning them on.
scenes.visual: binocular view: the sign flips: IT'S NOT ME TURNING THEM ON

scenes.narration: The window goes dark. And behind you... the light above the stairwell door... flickers on.
scenes.visual: rooftop, the bulb above the stairwell door buzzes on behind you, you turn

scenes.narration: Biscuit goes silent. He's staring at the door. Part two... if you want to know who's on those stairs.
scenes.visual: the dog frozen staring at a door slightly ajar, light spilling out, slow push in
